raw_preservation.definition: Every file under each source job except processed/; symlinks hash link text without following. Each per-job manifest maps relative path to SHA256; manifest digest is SHA256 of sorted compact JSON. Before/after equality was checked around each publication.

catalog_repair.operation: ordinary evallab ingest with explicit owned derived directory

calibration.scope: Separate agent-rater studies, never pooled. All republished pages show these measured opinions. Tail label bytes were source-SHA-bound in the retained har128-g2 tree but not yet on main at publication.

limits: No G5 outcome is claimed here; 18 refused G2 specs stay not_run and are not fabricated native zero outcomes.
Modal allocation is an accounting share of complete billed pools, including failed attempts/startup/warm/idle; Daytona remains an estimate, not per-job measured GPU utilization.
The seven C1 publications are included to close their shared serving-pool membership; their3-pass/4-fail gate result is unchanged.
All raw execution provenance, including any uncommitted-code badge, is retained.
Frozen G3 was not reselected or retrained. No experiment calls or deployments were made by this work.
